items.author: BBC Sport
items.excerpt: Lauren Price has a shot at becoming Wales' first undisputed world champion against Michaela Kotaskova on Friday after the vacant WBO welterweight title was added to the fight. The 32-year-old will go up against Czech Republic's Kotaskova in Cardiff in a fight that will be shown live on BBC Two and BBC iPlayer. Price will defending her IBF, WBA and WBC belts at Utilita Arena and will now have the chance to add a fourth.
